reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: Barely usable

reviews.title: You lose your data is your watch dies
reviews.text: It’s so dumb. I’ve had many issues where Slopes stops recording or if the watch dies, you lose your whole day of stats. Done paying for it. It used to work, and no longer does.

reviews.title: Amazing app - ruined sharing options
reviews.text:
Fantastic skiing and snowboarding tracking app, I use it every time I go snowboarding 🏂.

EDIT: It’s removed the brilliant square sharing cards it used to have & now has “modern” boring glassy vertical ones instead.

It’s a horrible downgrade!

It still great for recording your stats but has now removed the best part of the app in favour I assume of making it easier to share on Snapchat at the expense of everywhere else!

I hate that the old design I’ve been saving for every trip I’ve ever been on is gone and the new design is vertical or nothing! No square option anymore, no old styles.

reviews.title: Watch app always pops out
reviews.text: The watch app always pops out itself it is really annoying!

reviews.title: Interesting
reviews.text: I love the app and what it does but 50% of the time i click record and find that it stopped after a little bit.

reviews.title: Not the greatest.
reviews.text: We used it as a group, one friend had one view of the app, mine was different. Couldn’t navigate it, couldn’t see my group stats even though I joined it, pretty much would be a waste of money if I’d subscribe.

reviews.title: Flawed calorie counting
reviews.text: I found the calorie calculations to be too low by an order of magnitude. A whole day of skiing was giving me a calorie count of 15 calories. Ridiculous!

reviews.title: Fun app but shady business
reviews.text: Analytics and tracking worked well, then they dinged me for a full yr sub at the end of free trial. Be careful

reviews.title: Free tier loses even more features
reviews.text: They recently took away the route replay feature for free users which is so lame.

reviews.title: Crashed!
reviews.text: It crashes so often while loading trail information

reviews.title: Annoying shortcoming
reviews.text: The app for sure should be able to tell if I am skiing or driving my car. I always forget to stop it and then get max speed of driving instead of skiing.

reviews.title: The UI absolutely sucks
reviews.text: Want to click friends to view where your friend is on the map? Good luck finding how and where. Want to view your last run details specifically, you may eventually find it after clicking through various tabs and windows just to get to it. Abysmal UI/UX

reviews.title: Worst
reviews.text: This app is not worth it. It hasn’t recorded 2 of my added trips, it’s not user friendly.

reviews.title: Didn’t track anything
reviews.text: No cross country? I press start tracking, finished, and I see “no altitude recorded” or something. What?

reviews.title: Just meh
reviews.text: Way too overpriced for premium and way too basic in comparison to other free alternatives.

reviews.title: Barely works
reviews.text: Some days I could track my friends. Some days it wouldn’t track them. At one point it logged me out of the app and removed the trip I was in the middle of so I had try and rejoin it. Not easy to use.

reviews.title: The free version has almost nothing on it
reviews.text: No map, no tracking – don't think I will bother using it again

reviews.title: Premium does not work
